threads.label: Skips his water pill (furosemide) on bowling days, Tue and Thu
Takes ibuprofen most days for a bad right knee

steps.note: Pharmacist caught it from the kidney labs

threads.consequence: Ibuprofen keeps hurting his kidneys and holding fluid. Nobody tells him to stop.

threads.label: High-salt diet: canned soup and deli meat at the bowling alley; Ayşe cooks low salt at home
threads.consequence: Diet teaching covers home cooking only. The bowling-alley soup continues.

threads.label: Wife Ayşe fills his pill box; she reads little English and speaks Turkish
threads.consequence: Discharge papers go home in English to the person who can't read them.

teachback.tr: Anladığım kadarıyla: Weigh every morning after the bathroom, before breakfast, and write it down. Call if up 2 lb in a day or 5 lb in a week. Take the water pill every single morning, including bowling days. It can be taken after bowling instead of before if needed.
teachback.en: What I understood: Weigh every morning after the bathroom, before breakfast, and write it down. Call if up 2 lb in a day or 5 lb in a week. Take the water pill every single morning, including bowling days. It can be taken after bowling instead of before if needed.
